errors.text: The proposed oxide-tribofilm mechanism is impossible under the hidden molecular-dynamics setup, which contains no oxygen-bearing environment or oxidation chemistry.
The hypothesis substitutes macroscopic sprayed or cladded coatings on steel with a different composition and microstructure for the nanoscale FeNiCrCoCu coating on single-crystal Cu.
The proposed degradation threshold of 450–500 °C does not match the target boundary near 900 K, approximately 627 °C.
The cited evidence does not substantiate the claimed protective-oxide trend, tribofilm failure threshold, or initial decrease in friction and wear.
